== Problem ==

What is the product of <math> \frac{3}{2}\times\frac{4}{3}\times\frac{5}{4}\times\cdots\times\frac{2006}{2005} </math> ?

<math> \textbf{(A)}\ 1\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 1002\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 1003\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 2005\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 2006 </math>

== Solution ==
The numerator in each fraction cancels out with the denominator of the next fraction. There are only two numbers that didn't cancel: <math>\frac{2006}{2}=\boxed{\textbf{(C)}\ 1003} </math>.
